purpose: Illustrative visual bridge from actual Tesla footage to controlled teaching model; not actual vehicle demonstration

derivative.strategy: Video bitstream copy, remove provider audio only; preserve all 150 native frames in order at 30fps. No freeze/repeat/reverse/interpolation.

visualReview.reviewMethod: 15 representative native frames, 30 dense frames every five frames, full-resolution frames 45/60/75/90/149; all 150 frames decoded
positives: The main car remains one traceable inverted vehicle attached below a platform.
Camera travels around a car end to the other side and pulls back to the supplied teaching view.
No main-car duplication, black cut, detached wheel or abrupt view replacement observed in inspected frames.
Supplied beginning/end composition, contact orientation and vehicle footprint are closely retained.
limitations: Telemetry persists with original values then fades by about 2.2 seconds; it does not strictly slide out as requested.
Around 1.3-2.5 seconds the actual car end is simplified into the teaching model, including wheel-cover changes.
The dark stage transitions through lighting/material changes into the warm-gray studio; it is an AI explanatory bridge, not actual test footage.
